summary: Ansible 12 amazon.aws removed parameter aliases: access_token, aws_security_token and security_token (use session_token), boto_profile (profile), ec2_access_key (access_key), ec2_region (region), ec2_secret_key (secret_key), and endpoint, ec2_url and s3_url (endpoint_url); the aws_credentials docs fragment is removed.
questions: Why does ec2_region fail in amazon.aws?
Is security_token still an alias in amazon.aws?
